note: Rabobank's page for its Rabo GoldCard: with a Rabo Standaard package the first card costs 2.00 euros a month, and the month's card spending is taken from the current account in full between the 24th and the 28th of the next month, so nothing is carried on it. The main banks: ING, Rabobank and ABN AMRO, the Netherlands' three largest. On 2026-10-30 ING's site didn't answer an automated request and Rabobank's refused one (403), so the Rabo GoldCard read on 2026-10-29 is kept as it was and no ING card is written. ABN AMRO's credit card pages (read 2026-10-30): the ABN AMRO Credit Card (2.55 euros a month), Gold Card (4.45 euros a month; the overview gives the figure and the card's own page says it's charged by the month) and Studenten Creditcard (1.31 euros a month; for students, not checked), each card account collected from the current account automatically every month, so nothing is carried on them. Its rates page for everyday banking (read 2026-10-30) confirms the Credit Card's and Gold Card's monthly prices; none of the pages gives a cash, foreign currency or default fee for the cards.
